{{Top|leg}}
The '''Senate Committee on New World Discovery and Exploration''' was an organization within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were responsible for the funding as well as furthering exploration attempts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
